## LevelUP! Lower Player Stats
Adds a configurable debuff to all player stats to allow people to tone down the buffing effects of the LevelUP pack.

To configure the pack and see the current buffs and debuffs simply run 
```
/function hn_lower_player_stats_addon:change_config
```
